description:
## Question

Record the trust rule "clients submit work, never results" as an ADR, and add its glossary terms to CONTEXT.md.

## Context

Settled while charting map turnkey-wit (see its Notes). It is hard to reverse, surprising without context ("why can't CI write to the cache?"), and the result of a real trade-off — so it earns an ADR (/domain-modeling ADR format, next number in `docs/adr/`).

## What to write

- **ADR** "Clients submit work, never results": clients may upload content-store blobs (hash-verified) and submit Nix derivations; only the build service's executor writes action results and only its Nix builder produces signed store paths; trust root = the service and its operators; the code under build is irrelevant to integrity; results computed by the executor are shared across all clients, with the fallback (per-trust-level services, requester scopes) if Cloud Run cannot isolate successive actions; PR results are never promoted.
  - Considered options: **scoped writes** (the original "virtual buckets": each build writes its own scope, trunk written by builds of reviewed code — rejected as the destination; explain the forged-entry scenario: a PR iteration uploads a forged result under a legitimate key, a later clean iteration hits it); **CI-only writer** (research note §4a; rejected: laptops and PRs can't contribute, and CI jobs run untrusted PR code); **trusted executors** (chosen).
  - Consequences: remote execution becomes the core; the Nix cache needs no scopes; `turnkey-lbe.8`'s "test runner writes to a remote cache" is superseded; local execution remains for darwin/offline, and its results are never shared.
- **CONTEXT.md** (glossary only, no implementation): new section (e.g. "Build service") with **Build service**, **Executor** (_Avoid_: worker, runner, RBE), **Client** (_Avoid_: builder), **Client-computed result**. Check the existing **Reuse policy** entry ("written only into the local cache") and note any tension rather than silently rewriting it.

## Output

The ADR file and CONTEXT.md edits, committed (jj) with a message referencing this ticket; add the ADR link to `docs/specs/build-service.md` (create the spec skeleton if absent: title, destination paragraph from the map, empty sections per map ticket).
title: Record the trust rule "clients submit work, never results" as an ADR
